name: UCI MedAcademy
what_you_do: Spend 5 days learning about medical careers. You work in teams with actors who play patients. You take a medical history, examine them and work out a diagnosis.
who_can_apply: High school students, including this year's graduates, ages 15 to 19. You must be 15 by the first day of your session. You need one reference from a teacher, coach, administrator or counselor.
pay_detail: Tuition is $2,000. It is due two weeks before the session and cannot be refunded. Partial and full scholarships are available for financial hardship.
duration: 5 days. Listed 2027 sessions: June 21 to 25, June 28 to July 2 and July 12 to 16.
deadline_text: The application form says the 2027 application opens February 1, 2027. The program page says applications close March 1 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific, without a year, and lists sessions in summer 2027. Late applications are not accepted.
how_to_apply: Use the apply link on the program page. Have these ready: an unofficial transcript, your reference's name and email, and answers to three essay questions. Each essay has a 1,500-character limit.
notes: Sessions may change. Notices go out in mid-April. Your reference must email the letter by the same March 1 deadline. Scholarships are available to students with financial hardship.
